title: Citizen Kane
synopsis: You're a reporter. Charles Foster Kane has died saying one word. Rosebud. Find out what it means before the deadline.

nodes.text: Editor Rawlston wants a hook for the obituary. Rosebud, he says, is it.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.
“Object” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: A vault. The banker's memoirs. A child sled in the snow.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Path—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Speed.

nodes.text: Old, kind, loyal. He talks about Kane on the wharf.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Listen—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Press him” back. Job shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Kane buys the Inquirer. He writes a Declaration of Principles.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Note the document.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
“Note the timing” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: Kane buys the rival paper's whole staff. He throws a party.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Mark the loyalty.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Mark the ego.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: His old friend Leland talks honestly about love. He says Kane loved no one but himself.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Note the contradiction” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Take it as truth.” The story records the instinct as “Naive” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Emily Norton. The President's niece. Their marriage decays over breakfasts.

choices.text: Notice the marriage in the meals
choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.

nodes.text: He meets Susan Alexander on a street. She has a toothache. She sings, badly.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
You commit to “Move on.” The story records the instinct as “Job” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Kane runs for governor. He is, briefly, beloved.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Track the scandal” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Job.

nodes.text: Boss Jim Gettys finds Kane and Susan. The newspapers will run a story.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Note Kane's defiance.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: Kane loses the election. He loses Emily and Junior.

choices.consequence: “Note the cost” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.
“Tell yourself it was fate” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Story.

nodes.text: Kane builds her an opera house. She does not, in fact, sing well.

choices.consequence: “Talk to Susan now” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Direct.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Layered—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Susan, decades later, in a club. She drinks. She talks.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Be gentle with her” back. Care shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Kane's house. Crates. Statues. Echoes.

nodes.text: She leaves him in a marble room. He destroys her bedroom.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Notice the snowglobe” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He dies alone, the snowglobe falling.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Hold the image” back. Witness shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He says Rosebud was nothing. He doesn't know.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Suspect more” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Workers burn old junk in the basement. A sled.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Witness.
There is no taking “Look away” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: On the sled the word ROSEBUD chars and curls.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Witness.

nodes.text: You file the story without Rosebud's meaning.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You decide what kind of reporter to be next.

choices.consequence: “Stay” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Career.
There is no taking “Pivot to books” back. New shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You write a long book about Kane. It outlives the newspaper. People read it in college for decades.
You stay at the paper. You become managing editor. You think about Rosebud every Christmas, for some reason.
You leave reporting. You take a job at a small magazine that does, mostly, longer pieces. You marry, eventually. You name nothing Rosebud.
